temperature.name: Surface temperature anomaly
temperature.description: NASA combines air temperatures over land with water temperatures at the ocean surface to show how much warmer or cooler each area was than its historical average.

precipitation.name: Precipitation
precipitation.description: How much more or less rain and snow fell per day than usual, estimated from satellites and rain gauges.

sst.name: Sea surface temperature
sst.description: Temperature of the ocean surface, reconstructed from marine observations. Land is gray in this layer.
sst.product: NOAA Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature v6

moisture.name: Atmospheric water vapor
moisture.description: Total water vapor in the column of air overhead. One kilogram per square meter would make a millimeter of liquid water.

pressure.name: Sea level air pressure
pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure adjusted to sea level so places at different elevations can be compared.

wind.name: Near-surface wind speed
wind.description: How fast air moves 10 meters above the surface, averaged over time.

cloud.name: Total cloud cover
cloud.description: The share of the sky covered by clouds at any height. Differences are in percentage points.

air.name: Air temperature at 2 m
air.description: Temperature of the air two meters above land or ocean. The map shows how it differs from the cell’s 1991–2020 average.

skin.name: Surface skin temperature
skin.description: Temperature of Earth’s outermost surface, such as soil, vegetation, snow, or the ocean surface.

soil.name: Topsoil moisture
soil.description: The fraction of the top 10 centimeters of soil occupied by water. Changes are in percentage points.

soiltemp.name: Topsoil temperature
soiltemp.description: Average temperature in the top 10 centimeters of soil, where land estimates are available.

ice.name: Sea ice concentration
ice.description: The share of each ocean cell covered by sea ice. Changes are in percentage points, and land is gray.
ice.product: NOAA OISST v2 monthly sea ice concentration

shortwave.name: Incoming sunlight at the surface
shortwave.description: Solar energy reaching the surface per second and square meter after passing through the atmosphere.

latent.name: Latent heat flux at the surface
latent.description: Energy transferred when water changes phase at the surface, mainly through evaporation.

sensible.name: Sensible heat flux at the surface
sensible.description: Heat exchanged between the surface and the air because of a temperature difference.

olr.name: Outgoing longwave radiation
olr.description: Thermal infrared energy leaving Earth at the top of the atmosphere, measured as power per unit area.
